components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a
            leading '+' followed by 8-15 digits); national numbers default to the '+61' country code.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used. The effective date must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or Sunday (whether supplied or defaulted) is rolled forward to the next Monday.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). Optional; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (same last name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Owners that share a household return the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the canonical E.164 telephone, email is the trimmed lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the household identifier. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678|jean@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that share the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3. Every owner starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

          required:

## Summary

Added an optional `postcode` (4 digits) to owners, validated against the city's region only when present, and stored/returned when supplied — keeping the request contract backward-compatible.

**Region rule:** derived from the existing city→region table (`Sydney`→NSW, `Melbourne`→VIC, `Brisbane`→QLD). Ranges: NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099. A city with no known region (`UNKNOWN`) accepts any 4-digit postcode. Malformed or out-of-range → **400**; absent → accepted.

**Files changed:**
- `openapi.yml` — added `postcode` to `OwnerFields` (optional, not in `required`), which regenerates the DTO getter/setter that MapStruct maps automatically in both directions.
- `model/Owner.java` — new `postcode` column + accessors.
- DB schemas (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — new `postcode` column; the positional `hsqldb/data.sql` seed rows got a matching `NULL`.
- New `function/owner/Postcode.java` — the validation helper (format + region-range check, mirroring the existing `Locality` table).
- New `function/owner/RequirePostcode.java` — the pipeline step; skips when absent.
- New escalation `InvalidPostcodeException` + handler + YAML → responds 400 as a `ProblemDetail`, matching the existing `InvalidTelephoneException` convention.
- Wired `RequirePostcode` into `owners.POST.yml` (after `require`) and `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` (after `validate`); `ApplyOwner` now persists postcode on update.

**Design note:** the POST pipeline's first step binds `@RequestBody` *without* `@Valid`, so the OpenAPI `pattern` alone wouldn't reject a malformed postcode on create — hence the explicit `RequirePostcode` step rather than relying on bean validation.

**Verification:** the full suite (`mvn test`) passes — the three new acceptance tests (`coreStoresValidPostcode`, `coreAcceptsOwnerWithoutPostcode`, `errorRejectsMalformedPostcode`) plus a temporary test I added and then removed that confirmed out-of-range rejection, valid-in-region storage, and permissive unknown-region acceptance.
